mappings.visualRationale: Visibly portrays a large, predatory red-and-black spider actively crawling across a glowing violet web with conjuration wisps, perfectly conveying a drow priestess conjuring giant loyal spiders.

Visibly shows a central concussive detonation emitting violent, intersecting shockwave rings and pressure lines blasting outwards in all directions, matching a powerful sonic wave throwing nearby creatures back.

Visibly displays a golden clock dial with rapidly spinning, blurring hands surrounded by warping magenta temporal energy streaks, depicting the localized bending and distortion of time to freeze a target.
Visibly features a stark glowing white stopwatch frozen in place amid static floating motes on a deep blue stasis background, capturing the complete halting and suspension of universal time.

Visibly shows an unfurled parchment scroll bearing an all-seeing occult eye above inscribed runic characters and letters, cleanly illustrating the revelation and deciphering of a target creature's hidden True Name.

Visibly depicts the silhouette of a humanoid body dissolving and disintegrating into crumbling fragments and ash amidst a radiant purple aura, capturing the complete unmaking and destruction of matter.

Visibly shows an aggressive green serpent striking with open jaws, prominent white venom-dripping fangs, and a red tongue against toxic green plumes, directly matching a Viperian wizard casting venomous ranged damage.
Visibly portrays a luminous humanoid silhouette leaping across the empty dark void into a swirling violet interdimensional portal, perfectly representing long-distance planar/astral teleportation.
Visibly illustrates an outstretched purple hand firmly entangled and trapped across a spreading web of thick white spider silk, directly matching the immobilizing restraint of the Web spell.
Visibly depicts a shadowy face with smiling dark purple lips whispering insidious suggestions in the dark, capturing the deceptive murmurs and lowered spell resistance caused by a naga's whispers.
Visibly displays an emaciated, desiccated grey withered hand with claw-like fingers emerging from the darkness, epitomizing the life-draining necrotic rot and decay radiated by a lich.
